items.title: Actual PBPS finite-state reversal and incoming-rate product

source.anchor: Appendix A.1 actual prescribed trajectories, A5 incoming-rate match and A8 reversed event substitution
source.attribution: Chen, Chewi, Lu and Zhang, arXiv:2609.06905v1, Appendix A.1 event convention, reversal algebra, (A.5) and (A.8). Complete attributed ASTIS mathematical restatement with explicit finite-state indexing; not verbatim text or a full invariance theorem.

items.statement:
Let E be a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel sigma algebra, including dimension zero. Let V:E->R, alpha,beta>=0 and eta in R. Assume alpha>0, alpha<=beta, V is C2, alpha||v||^2<=D2V(x)[v,v]<=beta||v||^2 for every x,v in E, eta>0 and beta*eta<=1.
For y,r in E put c=y-eta grad V(r), h_r(x)=grad V(x)-grad V(r), R(x,p)=(x,-p),
Phi_(y,r,u)(x,p)=(c+cos(u)(x-c)+sqrt(eta)sin(u)p, -sin(u)/sqrt(eta)(x-c)+cos(u)p),
S_r(x,p)=(x,p-(2<p,h_r(x)>/||h_r(x)||^2)h_r(x)). Real division by zero is zero, so a zero normal gives the identity bounce. Let ell=volume_E tensor volume_E, with canonical Hilbert-space Lebesgue measure.
For every integer n>=0 and horizon T>=0, let Delta_n(T) consist of real tuples 0<t_0<...<t_(n-1)<T. Equivalently, prepending 0 produces a strictly increasing tuple and every entry is less than T. Let Prefix_n(T) be this subtype and m_n,T the comap of Lebesgue measure on R^n under its inclusion. This is unnormalized simplex volume. For n=0 the tuple is empty and its zero-dimensional volume is one; for T=0 and n>0 the subtype is empty.
Write q_0=0 and q_(j+1)=t_j. Starting at z_0=z, define z_(j+1)=S_r(Phi_(y,r,t_j-q_j)(z_j)) for 0<=j<n. Define records K_j=(q_j,z_j), each embedded in the live branch of (R_nonnegative x (E x E)) plus a cemetery symbol. For a general history of n+1 such records, the path reconstruction Psi at s in [0,T] starts from z and visits records in increasing index order: a live record (a,w) replaces the accumulator by Phi_(y,r,s-a)(w) exactly when a<=s; future records and cemetery records leave it unchanged. Here s-a is nonnegative subtraction. Define Gamma_(y,r,z,t)=Psi(K), the actual finite prescribed path; thus its value at an event is the post-bounce value. Let A_(y,r)(z,t)=Gamma_(y,r,z,t)(T).
Define lambda_r(x,p)=sqrt(eta) max(0,<p,grad V(x)-grad V(r)>). For every finite n>=0 and T>=0 there exists rho:Prefix(n,T)->Prefix(n,T) with (rho(t))_i=T-t_(n-1-i). This witness is produced, not assumed. For every y,r,z and t in Prefix(n,T), form the grid a=(0,t_0,...,t_(n-1),T), indexed from0 through n+1. Set post_j=zAt(y,r,z,n,T,t,j) and arrive_j=Phi_(a_(j+1)-a_j)(post_j) for j=0,...,n. Set A=Gamma(y,r,z,n,T,t)(T), the actual terminal state. Form the reversed grid abar=(0,rho(t)_0,...,rho(t)_(n-1),T), set barPost_j=zAt(y,r,R(A),n,T,rho(t),j), and barArrive_j=Phi_(abar_(j+1)-abar_j)(barPost_j).
For every j=0,...,n, barPost_j=R(arrive_(n-j)) and barArrive_j=R(post_(n-j)). Moreover product over i=0,...,n-1 of lambda_r(barArrive_i) equals product over i=0,...,n-1 of lambda_r(arrive_i). The last arrival arrive_n is the actual terminal state and is not one of the n event-rate factors. Reversal on the n+1 arcs is j->n-j; reversal on the n events is i->n-1-i. Per-event rate equality is proved internally; the public conclusion exports the paired states and product equality.
The theorem covers n=0 (one flow arc and empty products equal1), T=0, rank-zero spaces, zero reflection normals and zero rates. No division by a rate or positivity of a prescribed event rate is assumed. The original six analytic assumptions are the only analytic premises; reversal identities, inverse maps, terminal identification and incoming-rate matching are derived from actual producers. The exact unnormalized simplex measure m is retained in the literal interface but is unused in these pointwise deterministic conclusions.
This is the finite-state and incoming-rate component of the Appendix A.1 reversal proof. At a genuine event the right-continuous post-event value reverses to the original incoming value, not the original post-event value. No equality of the two right-continuous trajectories at all times is claimed. Survival time substitution, weighted density equality, stationary invariance, restart/Markovness, hypocoercivity, implementation errors, actual expected costs, main results and PBPS/SPHMC composition remain separate.
assumptions: Finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel E, including rank zero.
alpha,beta>=0; alpha>0; alpha<=beta; V is C2; alpha||v||^2<=D2V(x)[v,v]<=beta||v||^2 for every x,v; eta>0; beta*eta<=1.
Every finite n>=0 and T>=0; rho is produced on the strict prescribed-event subtype, then every y,r,z,t is quantified. No positive rate or nonzero-normal condition.
Literal actual flow, zero-safe reflection, finite recursion, interpolated path, endpoint, momentum reversal and rate; no supplied reversal or inverse-map premise.
